en: Vintage black‑and‑white view of a busy harborfront with steamships docked along a quay and cobblestone streets filled with horse‑drawn carts and a few early motor vehicles. The masts and funnels of several ships rise above low waterfront warehouses. There are handwritten labels over some ships, and printed caption text at the lower right that reads "Stockholm. Skeppsbron". Large, stately buildings and a domed structure are visible across the water in the background.
